Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
is pounce a hand strike?

does the reacting vampire have to pay one blood when playing gestalt? for me
the phrase "including this vampire" is not totally clear. can i let 1, 2, or
3 other bloodbrothers pay 1 blood for intercept, while the blood brother
actually playing the card doens'nt pay?

regards

pallando

------------------------
Pounce
Combat, Flight

Requires a ready minion with flight

Strike: strength +2 damage, and the opposing minion cannot strike for the
remainder of the round (this doesn't affect the current strike resolution).
If this strike is dodged, this striking minion takes 1 damage during strike
resolution and the opposing minion gets an optional press.
-----------------------
Gestalt
Reaction, Sanguinus

Choose X ready Blood Brothers you control who belong to the same circle as
this reacting vampire (including this vampire). Each chosen vampire must
burn a blood, or this card has no effect.

+X intercept

+X intercept, and this vampire may play cards as if he or she possessed all
of the chosen Blood Brother's disciplines for the remainder of the action

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
> is pounce a hand strike?

Yes.

> does the reacting vampire have to pay one blood when playing gestalt? for me
> the phrase "including this vampire" is not totally clear. can i let 1, 2, or
> 3 other bloodbrothers pay 1 blood for intercept, while the blood brother
> actually playing the card doens'nt pay?

"including this vampire" should make it clear.
You choose some vampires (including this one).
The chosen vampires burn a blood each.

Since the reacting vampire is explicitly included in the list of chosen
vampires, he must burn a blood.
